messages.subject: possible bug involving iid2d model
parts:
Dear all,

It looks like there's a problem with the iid2d model in the latest development version of INLA. Running the demo leads to a segfault: with the verbose option on, I get:

Store results in directory[/tmp/RtmpnI2tNQ/file7cba5c4cf7dd/results.files]
Segmentation fault

if I replace "iid2d" with "iid", the problem disappears. Here's the code I'm using, it's simply a copy-and-paste from the PDF:
n = 1000
N = 2*n
rho = 0.5
## set variances
Sigma = matrix(c(1/1, NA, NA, 1/2), 2, 2)
## and the correlation
Sigma[1,2] = Sigma[2,1] = rho*sqrt(Sigma[1,1]*Sigma[2,2])
## need it to simulate data
library(mvtnorm)
## first example
y = yy = rmvnorm(n, sigma=Sigma)
y = c(y[,1], y[,2])
i = 1:N
formula = y ~ f(i, model="iid2d", n=N)
r = inla(formula, data = data.frame(i,y),
control.data=list(initial=10,fixed=TRUE),verbose=T)


Best,

Simon Barthelmé
